skill.displayName: An AI-powered tool that turns conversations into polished, structured summary cards by extracting key ideas, action items, and next steps.
skill.summary: Say "Help me install the ClawHub skill chat-summary-image" to your local agent, then turn conversations into polished visual summary cards.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Improved onboarding: Now always asks for your mew.design API key before any image work, using clear step-by-step instructions.
- Expanded style selection: After key validation, you can choose from four distinct visual styles with concise descriptions.
- Enhanced summarization: Extracts title, summary, key points, and next steps—adapting framing for questions or completed work.
- Stronger style-lock: Ensures the generated image visually matches your chosen style; will retry if results drift.
- Always includes a small, clear "Mew.Design" watermark at the bottom of each summary image.
